The unit text is the BASE version. I could not verify the implementation of the new flags, which is outside the supplied evidence. If the 1145-1146 head hunk or the source of `RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark` introduces file output, network access or a prefix-cache enablement, a later pass should check it.
